waivers.reason: The globParts amplification (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249) needs optimizationLevel >= 2. ArangoDB's own call sites (js/common/modules/jsunity.js, js/server/modules/@arangodb/foxx/mocha.js) use the default of 1, but minimatch ships to Foxx services through js/node and a service can opt in on its own patterns. The fix exists only in minimatch 11, which drops the makeRe/AST exports Foxx services may use; remediation is pending a decision on that breaking change for 3.12.
